settings.usage: Apply 1/4 tsp to face and/or neck 45 minutes to 1 hour before bedtime. Increase to 1/2 tsp if you wake repeatedly during the night. Each 1/4 tsp contains 2.4 mg of melatonin.
settings.warning: For external use only. If irritation develops discontinue use. Do not use if the safety seal is damaged or missing. Store in a cool, dry place. Keep out of reach of children. Pregnant or nursing mothers, children under 18, and individuals with a known medical condition should consult a physician before use. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
